text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: The race will be starting soon. I shall never grow tired of tasting this excitement.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: My previous result was pitiful, but I've put it out of mind.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I've done all I can to prepare. All that's left is to unleash my full power.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes, I shall be on my way then. I'll see you once the race has concluded.
